title: Hello, Daisy
overview: Pechka is an unassuming magical girl whose magic lets her make delicious food, which she uses to prepare a lunch for the boy she has a crush on. Her modest everyday life changes completely when she is forcibly abducted into an ominous game world. Sixteen magical girls have been gathered there alongside Pechka. In this artificial virtual space, the curtain quietly rises on a nightmare that is as beautiful as it is cruel.

title: The Players
overview: Sixteen magical girls have been assembled in a vast virtual world. The electronic fairy Fal announces a team competition with a 10-billion-yen grand prize, where players must collect “Candy.” With Pechka panicking over her complete lack of combat ability, Clantail takes the lead in redistributing the Candy. But could this become the seed of quiet mistrust among the group?

title: Delicious Food Makes Everyone Happy
overview: Pechka and Nako begin exploring the grasslands, making their way past traps and opening a treasure chest filled with a huge amount of Candy. Their relief is short-lived when a mysterious forced-transport system activates, dragging every player into the plaza! Meanwhile, Akane continues her unsettling solo movements. In an instant, the game begins to tilt toward catastrophe.

title: The Detective and the Murder
overview: Daisy, who was supposed to have merely been eliminated from the game, suddenly dies under mysterious circumstances in the real world. When detective Detec Bell makes a shocking accusation, Fal confirms the cruel truth and declares that clearing the game is the only path to survival! Then Masked Wonder’s mutilated body is discovered, and a search begins for the culprit behind the theft of a rare item.

title: Mysterious Candy
overview: A giant robot and a gigantic Cherna clash spectacularly in the wasteland over an item! Pechka and the others advance into a new underground area, the “Limestone Cave,” defeating monsters along the way. But just before they log out, Fal announces a merciless new rule. With death only 15 minutes away, a desperate race against time for survival begins!

title: The Giant Dragon and the Chinese Girl
overview: Though at the mercy of a desperate set of rules, the girls force themselves to smile and press deeper into the dark cave. Along the way, Pechka frantically copies down a “mysterious message” carved into a stone wall that may hold the key to clearing the game. Then the greatest and most powerful threat yet, the Great Dragon, stands in their path.

title: Negative and Positive
overview: Snow White finally appears before the mastermind. Meanwhile, the fierce battle with the Great Dragon tests the girls’ unity as they struggle to survive. But behind their earnest hopes, the game board grows even more ominously distorted, producing yet another casualty.

title: Lazuline Dream
overview: In a real-world entertainment district, Bell sees through Lazuline’s true identity. Invited to her home, Bell learns about the distinctive habits that remain even after transformation and the secret lineage of a name inherited from the original Lazuline. But in the middle of their calm conversation, Bell is suddenly struck by a horrific flashback! What is the full truth behind the blood-soaked test sealed away in her memory?
